name: 01-session
run:
mend run --project verify-fixture --name preview-ws-$(date +%s) --detach --json -- sh -c 'mkdir -p .mend && cat > .mend/mend.toml <<TOML
[service.web]
command = "python3 -m http.server 8000"
port = 8000
browserScheme = "http"

[service.broken]
command = "echo broken starts and gives up; exit 3"
port = 8001
browserScheme = "http"
TOML
exec sleep 7204'
